scene: You scramble onto the rooftop transit deck overlooking glittering neon air lanes.
picture: Side-scrolling flat view of a busy rooftop dock. Far left sits a solar-sail junk at a wooden mooring post. Left, the player stands on roller skates. Centre, a spherical glass cloud cable pod hangs tethered. Right, a ticket barrier faces a waiting bullet train along a rail line at the far right edge.
shown: A docked wooden junk with glowing solar sails waiting on the far left
A round glass cable pod swaying gently on its wire in the centre
A sleek silver bullet train resting at a passenger boarding gate far right
